news.title: Lynx Machinery and Commercials Limited to Report Q4, 2026 Results on May 30, 2026
news.body: Lynx Machinery and Commercials Limited announced that they will report Q4, 2026 results at 12:15 PM, Indian Standard Time on May 30, 2026

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 2 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 2 independent directors. 3 non-independent directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Zankhana Bhansali was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2024. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.
